churches.name: Legacy Christian Church
churches.founded: 1969 (as Johnson County Christian Church; per lcc.org timeline)
churches.denomination_detail: Independent Christian Church / Restoration (Stone-Campbell) heritage per lcc.org/our-beliefs-and-heritage. Five campuses: Overland Park (Antioch Rd), Blue Valley (Metcalf Ave), Olathe KS, Lee’s Summit MO, Iglesia Hispana.
churches.overall_label: YELLOW — live-fetched 2026-10-23; orthodox statement of faith; Restoration-Movement baptism emphasis; full rubric pending

score_notes.christology: Statement: Jesus Christ the one and only Son of God who died for our sins and arose from the dead (1 Cor 15:1-8); will return and reign (1 Thess 4:13-18).
score_notes.scripture: Statement: the Bible is the inspired word of God (2 Tim 3:16); heritage page affirms Scripture as the church’s only rule for faith and practice.
score_notes.gender: Male Senior Pastor Dave VanDonge and male Executive Pastor; all five administrative elders male (lcc.org/contact). Women serve as ministry directors, not pastors or elders.
score_notes.leadership: Elder-led (administrative elder board of five) with senior pastor; independent autonomous congregation.
score_notes.soteriology: Statement: forgiveness through trusting Christ as Savior and Lord (John 3:16); converts “repent, confess their faith and be baptized into Him” (Acts 2:38). Restoration-Movement framing of baptism; how it relates to justification not spelled out on accessed pages.
score_notes.denominational: Independent Christian Church (Restoration / Stone-Campbell). No creed or denominational confession; accountability is congregational.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Men’s-specific ministry not advertised on accessed pages.
score_notes.preaching: Not yet assessed; sermons at watch.lcc.org.
score_notes.mission: Stated goal: make disciples; Great Commandment and Great Commission cited.

churches.assessment: Legacy Christian Church is an independent, multi-campus Christian Church in the Restoration (Stone-Campbell) tradition, founded in March 1969 as Johnson County Christian Church. Senior Pastor Dave VanDonge; elder-led with an all-male administrative elder board. The published statement of faith is orthodox on Christ, Scripture, sin, and the return of Christ, and follows the Restoration pattern on conversion (repent, confess, be baptized). Default yellow pending a full rubric review of preaching and practice.
churches.gender_detail: Male senior/executive pastors; all-male elder board (lcc.org/contact, 2026-10-23).
